plugin.name: I have read and understand the above warnings
plugin.description:
If you use Uneducated Shooter (https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/mods/56789), you MUST disable the inertia from that mod or your first person arms WILL BREAK in-game. Files with correct settings are provided in this download, but you must make sure you:
1. Overwrite any settings files from Uneducated Shooter if you have that installed. 2. Delete any settings files for Uneducated Shooter in your MO2 Overwrite folder. They are provided with this mod.
OR install this mod from JAG337: https://www.nexusmods.com/fallout4/mods/107443
You may need to redo your lean settings in-game if you changed them from default. Please do NOT post comments about this if you don't read or follow these instructions. Thanks and happy modding!
Selecting this option installs the full FP Gunplay Overhaul package (F4SE plugin, INI, presets, PDB) and safe Uneducated Shooter MCM override settings (inertia disabled).

plugin.name: I understand: disable or uninstall other crouch slide mods
plugin.description:
FP Gunplay Overhaul includes an optional Crouch Slide feature (Extras tab in the in-game settings menu).
If you plan to use that feature, you MUST disable or uninstall any other crouch sliding mods before playing. Running multiple crouch slide implementations at once will conflict (movement, crouch state, animation keywords, and input handling) and can cause broken player movement or animation.
If you do not enable Crouch Slide in this mod's settings, other crouch slide mods may remain installed.
Selecting this option confirms you have read the warning. Installation continues with the package selected on the previous page.
